This source replacement retains 81 upstream production/module/license files
and adds canary_own_data.go. The helper inspects own data-property metadata
without invoking an accessor or allocating a JavaScript descriptor object.
Canary rejects proxies before calling it. No host API is exposed to expressions.
CANARY_PATCH.json records the upstream module h1 checksum and every original
file hash, plus the added helper hash. There is no module-cache modification.
